enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up to chest. Remains still. Turns onto left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Breathes steadily. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Turns onto back. Adjusts blanket. Remains asleep. Continues sleeping.

Walks into Bathroom. Turns on Light. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs soap between hands. Washes face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Takes off sleepwear. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Turns off Light. Walks out.

Walks into Kitchen. Opens Refrigerator. Takes out milk, eggs, and butter. Closes Refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and plate. Cracks eggs into bowl and whisk eggs. Turns on InductionCooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours eggs into pan and stirs. Turns off cooker. Places eggs on plate. Places bread in Toaster. Presses lever. Spreads butter on toast. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Picks up fork and eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Stands up, carries dishes to sink, rinses, places in Dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Living Room. Picks up clothes from sofa and folds them. Places folded clothes in pile. Picks up magazines and stacks them. Places magazines on shelf. Picks up cups and carries them to Kitchen. Returns to Living Room. Picks up pillows and places them on sofa. Opens storage cabinet. Takes out VacuumCleaner. Plugs cord into outlet. Presses power button. Pushes VacuumCleaner across floor. Pulls VacuumCleaner backward. Lifts sofa edge and vacuums under sofa. Moves coffee table and vacuums under it. Pushes VacuumCleaner along baseboards. Presses power button. Unplugs cord and wraps it. Places VacuumCleaner in storage cabinet and closes cabinet.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local market
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks to local market. Enters market. Picks up shopping basket. Picks up apples. Places apples in basket. Picks up bananas. Places bananas in basket. Picks up tomatoes. Places tomatoes in basket. Picks up milk. Places milk in basket. Picks up eggs. Places eggs in basket. Picks up bread. Places bread in basket. Walks to checkout. Places items on counter. Pays cashier. Places items in reusable bags. Picks up bags. Walks out of market. Walks home.

Walks into Kitchen. Places bags on counter. Opens Refrigerator. Takes milk from bag. Places milk in Refrigerator. Takes eggs from bag. Places eggs in Refrigerator. Takes vegetables from bag. Places vegetables in Refrigerator. Closes Refrigerator. Opens cabinet. Takes cans from bag. Places cans in cabinet. Takes pasta from bag. Places pasta in cabinet. Closes cabinet. Takes bread from bag. Places bread on counter. Takes fruit from bag. Places fruit in bowl. Folds reusable bags. Places reusable bags in drawer. Wipes counter.

Walks into Kitchen. Opens Refrigerator. Takes out leftovers. Takes out lettuce. Closes Refrigerator. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Takes out cutting board. Places cutting board on counter. Places lettuce on cutting board. Cuts lettuce. Opens cabinet. Takes out plate. Places lettuce on plate. Opens Microwave. Places leftovers in Microwave. Closes Microwave. Presses buttons. Microwave beeps. Opens Microwave. Takes out leftovers. Places leftovers on plate. Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Stands up. Carries plate to sink. Rinses plate. Places plate in Dishwasher. Wipes table.

enriched_activities.activity: Jogging and doing outdoor exercise in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks to park. Starts jogging. Swings arms. Jogs along path. Breathes steadily. Continues jogging. Stops at bench. Places hands on hips. Stretches right leg. Stretches left leg. Bends forward. Does lunges. Does squats. Does push-ups. Stands up. Jogs back along path. Slows to walk. Walks home. Enters house.

Walks into Bathroom. Turns on Light. Turns on WaterHeater. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Rubs soap on body. Rinses body. Picks up shampoo. Applies shampoo to hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Picks up clothes. Puts on clothes. Hangs towel. Turns off Light. Walks out.

Walks into Living Room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns on TV. Presses channel button. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Changes channel. Watches TV. Stands up. Stretches arms. Sits down. Picks up Phone. Checks Phone. Places Phone on table. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer to plan upcoming community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Sits at desk. Turns on DeskLamp. Opens Computer. Presses power button. Waits for Computer to start. Types password. Opens calendar. Opens document. Types program plan. Clicks mouse. Scrolls page. Types notes. Opens email. Reads email. Types reply. Sends email. Saves document. Closes document. Closes email. Turns off Computer. Turns off DeskLamp. Stands up.

Walks into Kitchen. Opens Refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out chicken. Closes Refrigerator. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Takes out cutting board. Places cutting board on counter. Places vegetables on cutting board. Cuts vegetables. Turns on InductionCooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Places chicken in pan. Stirs chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs mixture. Adds seasoning. Turns off cooker. Places food on plate.

Walks into Kitchen. Sits at table. Picks up fork. Picks up knife. Cuts food. Lifts fork to mouth. Chews food. Swallows. Cuts more food. Eats food. Drinks water. Takes second serving. Eats second serving. Drinks water. Stands up. Carries plate to sink. Scrapes plate. Rinses plate. Places plate in Dishwasher. Wipes table. Turns off Light. Walks out.

Walks into Living Room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Turns on TV. Opens streaming app. Selects film. Presses play. Watches film. Adjusts volume. Pauses film. Stands up. Walks to Kitchen. Returns with snack. Sits on sofa. Resumes film. Watches film. Eats snack. Presses stop. Turns off TV. Places remote on table. Stands up. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bathroom. Turns on Light. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs soap between hands. Washes face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Dries face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Picks up floss. Flosses teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off Light. Walks out.

Walks into Bedroom 1. Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Reads page. Turns page. Adjusts pillow. Lies on bed. Reads page. Turns page. Reads page. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Picks up Phone. Sets alarm. Places Phone on charger. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Turns onto side.

Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns onto left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Breathes steadily. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Turns onto back. Remains asleep. Continues sleeping.
